The most recent version I found is **Next.js 16.2.10**, but the sources disagree on dates and none is from today, so it should be verified.

- **Versionlog** lists 16.2.10 as the latest stable, released July 1, 2026. Its page is dated July 13, 2026, about three months before today (October 16, 2026), so it may be stale. The same page lists 15.5.20 as the latest in the 15 line and says the 15 line's support ends October 21, 2026. (Latest Stable 16.2.10 Released 01 Jul 2026)
- **An ABHS blog post** says 16.2.7 was the current stable on npm as of June 10, 2026, and advises confirming with the npm command. (The current stable version of Next.js as of June 10, 2026 is Next.js 16.2.7. That is the exact version npm install next resolves to today)
- **Hashnode** describes 16.2.0 as the latest stable as of April 2026, which is older than both. (Next.js 16.2.0 is the latest stable version of Next.js as of April 2026.)

Next.js 16 is the active major line. Next.js 16 became stable in October 2025, and the 16.x line has since received steady minor and patch releases. Since the sources conflict and the newest one is months old, the reliable check is `npm show next version` or the Next.js releases page.

The newest version I found is **Next.js 16.2.10**, released **July 1, 2026**. I couldn't confirm it's still the latest as of today (October 16, 2026), because the sources are months old and don't agree.

- **16.2.10:** Versionlog lists it as the latest stable, released July 1, 2026. That page is dated July 13, so a newer patch or minor may exist since.
- **16.2.7:** An older blog post gave this as the current stable on npm as of June 10, 2026.
- **Major line:** Next.js 16 has been the active major line since it went stable in October 2025. Versionlog says support for the 15.x line ends October 21, 2026.

To get the current answer, run `npm show next version`. The Next.js GitHub releases page also lists it.

Sources:
- [Versionlog: Next.js latest stable](https://versionlog.com/nextjs/)
- [ABHS: Next.js latest version](https://abhs.in/blog/nextjs-current-version-march-2026-stable-release-whats-new)
- [Hashnode: Next.js 16.2 release](https://hashnode.com/tag/next-js-16)
- [Next.js support policy](https://nextjs.org/support-policy)
